Lokrath is a goods & commodity delivery service from Prayagraj. Book a vehicle to carry hardware, electricals, furniture, appliances and more from any shop to your door.
How do I book a delivery?
Enter the pickup and destination, add your goods details, pick a vehicle and tap Book. You only need to sign in at the last step.
How is the price worked out?
The price depends on distance, the vehicle and your goods. The booking summary shows every charge. The final price is confirmed when you book.
Lokrath only shows vehicles that can carry your goods\' weight and size. Pick the smallest one that fits to keep the fare low.
Enter your mobile number, then the 6-character code (letters and numbers) we send you. No email is needed.
How do I change the language?
Tap the language icon at the top of the home screen and choose English or हिन्दी.
Your deliveries will appear here once you book.
A few simple habits keep every delivery safe.
Pack goods securely and label fragile items before the driver arrives.
Check the vehicle and driver details before you load anything.
Hand over goods only for the booking ID you were given, and share it with the receiver.
Never share your sign-in code with anyone, including people who say they are from Lokrath.
Keep cash and valuables out of the load.
Do not book illegal, hazardous or prohibited goods.
In an emergency, contact the police, fire or ambulance services right away.
